global_rules.when: pack_type == genre_overlay and no base era/site context
global_rules.message: Wuxia/Xianxia cannot substitute for a historical era. Select a base context or mark the world fictional.

global_rules.when: era == dunhuang and strict_reconstruction and no subperiod/site
global_rules.message: Strict Dunhuang reconstruction requires a narrower cave/subperiod or evidence family.

global_rules.when: user explicitly requests conflicting period/culture elements
global_rules.message: Preserve the requested hybrid but label it intentional; do not call it strict reconstruction.

global_rules.when: a reference imports attributes outside assigned roles

evidence_behavior.source_conflict: preserve competing interpretations; never silently collapse to certainty
evidence_behavior.survival_bias: distinguish original appearance from surviving/conserved state
evidence_behavior.weak_evidence: never promote rare/unknown evidence to canonical by wording
evidence_behavior.explicit_user_vs_strictness: when explicit requested element conflicts with explicit strict reconstruction, preserve user intent as a visible conflict and adapt/propose a safer substitute rather than silently claiming authenticity
